story_type: helicopter matches a speeding boat to hoist a shark bite victim, filmed air to air
hook: A shark bit him. The helicopter caught the boat at speed.
narration: A shark bit a man near the Farallon Islands.
The boat carrying him kept running at speed, and a Coast Guard helicopter matched it.
It was an Air Station San Francisco crew, off the coast of San Francisco.
A helicopter flying forward gets extra lift and holds steadier than one hovering still, so nobody has to stop.
The basket went down to the speeding deck.
Then it came back up with the man.
outcome: The air crew handed the man to medical staff at Stanford University Medical Center.
title: Shark bite victim hoisted off a speeding boat
description:
On Oct. 23, 2018, a Coast Guard Air Station San Francisco helicopter crew medevaced a man bitten by a shark near the Farallon Islands off San Francisco and transferred him to medical personnel at Stanford University Medical Center.
